name: qatlas
description: QAtlas: aplicación de escritorio local-first y cifrada para testing de aplicaciones web

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/redaction && tsc -p packages/crypto && tsc -p packages/db && tsc -p packages/runner && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p security-tests && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run nativos:verificar && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit:electron
scripts.test:e2e: npm run navegador:verificar && playwright test && npm run navegador:verificar && npm run test:crypto:electron
scripts.navegador:instalar: playwright install --no-shell chromium && npm run navegador:verificar
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --project unit --coverage packages/crypto packages/redaction packages/db packages/shared packages/runner apps/desktop/src/main/boveda apps/desktop/src/main/proyectos apps/desktop/src/main/ejecuciones
